sourceReview: Supabase Auth official SMTP, password and rate limits documentation

liveConfiguration.whyUnknown: Current connected Supabase tools support project, advisors, SQL, functions, docs but not reading the project Auth configuration. No attempt to access Management API tokens, real email accounts or send emails.

documentaryConstraints.builtInSMTP: Supabase's default SMTP is for testing and only permits delivery to pre-authorized team addresses; custom SMTP is required to send reliably to public recipients.
documentaryConstraints.redirectRules: Site URL and allowed redirect URLs must be reviewed and pinned for the approved production domain; avoid broad wildcards.
documentaryConstraints.abuseMitigations: Provider-side Auth rate limiting/SMTP settings must be checked; UI error messages are not provider-level enforcement.

riskRegister.reason: No proof of custom SMTP configuration, sender domain ownership, delivery or inbox filtering
No proof production callback and recovery URLs are allowed and restricted
No access to current Auth verification/email/OTP limits
QA preview password field says minimum 8; session reset module enforces minimum 10; align before enabling
No inbox-delivered real recovery link, expiry and session invalidation test
P1.3 Free-tier compromised-password protection still not available
